==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|enduer|indure||obsolete}} ===Etymology=== {{etymon|en|id=tolerate|:inh|enm:enduren|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|enduren}}, from {{der|en|fro|endurer}}, from {{der|en|la|indūrō||to make hard}}. Displaced Old English {{m|ang|drēogan}}, which survives dialectally as {{m|en|dree}}. {{doublet|en|dure}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{a|en|RP}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈd͡ʒʊə(ɹ)/|[ɪnˈd͡ʒʊə̯(ɹ)]|a=yod-coalescence,non-pour-poor}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈd͡ʒɔː(ɹ)/|a=yod-coalescence,pour-poor}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈdjʊə(ɹ)/|[ɪnˈdjʊə̯(ɹ)]|a=non-<>,non-pour-poor}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈdjɔː(ɹ)/|a=non-<>,pour-poor}} * {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈd͡ʒoː/|a=SSB}} * {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈd(j)ʊɹ/|/ɪnˈdɝ/|a=GA}} * {{audio|en|en-us-endure.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|ʊə(ɹ)|s=2}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[continue]] or [[carry on]], [[despite]] [[obstacle]]s or [[hardship]]s; to [[persist]]. #: {{syn|en|carry on|plug away|Thesaurus:persevere}} #: {{ux|en|The singer's popularity '''endured''' for decades.}} #* {{RQ:Tennyson In Memoriam|XVIII|30|[…] The life that almost dies in me:
That dies not, but '''endures''' with pain,
⁠And slowly forms the firmer mind,
⁠Treasuring the look it cannot find,
The words that are not heard again.}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[tolerate]] or [[put up with]] something [[unpleasant]]. #: {{syn|en|bear|thole|take|Thesaurus:tolerate}} # {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[last]]. #: {{syn|en|go on|hold on|persist|Thesaurus:persist}} #: {{ux|en|Our love will '''endure''' forever.}} #* {{RQ:KJV|Job|8|15|page=622|column=2|text=He ſhall leane vpon his houſe, but it ſhall not ſtand: he ſhal hold it faſt, but it ſhall not '''endure'''.}} # To remain [[firm]], as under [[trial]] or [[suffering]]; to [[suffer]] patiently or without yielding; to [[bear up]] under [[adversity]]; to [[hold out]]. #: {{syn|en|resist|survive|withstand}} #* {{RQ:KJV|Ezekiel|22|14|page=908|column=1|text=Can thine heart '''indure''', ''or'' can thine hands be ſtrong in the dayes that I ſhall deale with thee?}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[suffer]] [[patiently]]. #: {{syn|en|accept|thole|withstand}} #: {{ux|en|He '''endured''' years of pain.}} #* {{quote-web |en |date=April 11, 2011 |author=Phil McNulty |title=Liverpool 3 - 0 Man City |work=BBC Sport |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/9449111.stm |page= |passage={{w|Dirk Kuyt}} sandwiched a goal in between {{w|Andy Carroll|Carroll}}'s double as City '''endured''' a night of total misery, with captain {{w|Carlos Tevez}} limping off early on with a hamstring strain that puts a serious question mark over his participation in Saturday's FA Cup semi-final against Manchester United at Wembley.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260909081202/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/9449111.stm|archivedate=9 September 2026}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} To [[indurate]].
